title: Finite quotient compatibility on flat K-flat pullback tensor pairs
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes, and integers $0\leq n\leq m$. Write $A_j=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{j+1}$. Use the intrinsic finite pullbacks $F_j$, tensors $T_{W,j}$ and canonical comparisons $\mu_j$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction], and the quotient extensions $Q_W:D(W,A_m)\to D(W,A_n)$, their universal K-flat model counits and normalized tensor comparisons $\tau_W$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $c$ be an ordinary comparison from pullback at m followed by quotient extension over X to quotient extension over Y followed by pullback at n. Assume c preserves the actual iterated adjunction-unit sections of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]: the quotient unit applied to the inverse-image unit of x maps to the inverse-image unit of the quotient unit of x. Let cc be a cochain comparison with degree-i component c at the degree-i term of every complex. Assume a function good witnesses that the level-m pullback preserves K-flat complexes. Let $e:F_m Q_X\simeq Q_Y F_n$ satisfy the full K-flat counit square: for every K-flat R, e at Q(R), followed by F_n of the quotient model over Y and the level-n exact-pullback factorization, equals Q_X of the level-m factorization followed by the quotient model over X on the pulled-back R and the derived quotient of cc at R. For flat-term K-flat complexes P,Q of normalized A_m-module sheaves on Y [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], put M=Q_Y(P), N=Q_Y(Q), where Q_Y here denotes derived localization. Then, in traversal order, $$Q_X(\mu_m(M,N))\,\tau_X(F_mM,F_mN)\,T_{X,n}(e_M,e_N)=e_{T_{Y,m}(M,N)}\,F_n(\tau_Y(M,N))\,\mu_n(Q_YM,Q_YN).$$ Only these representative pairs are asserted. There is no boundedness, constructibility, quotient-flatness or nonzero-object hypothesis. The chosen evaluation calculus is the one of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core].

proof.text: Use the specified flat-term K-flat P and Q to compute the derived tensor by the ordinary direct-sum total tensor. The tensor total is again K-flat. The exact inverse images and the quotient K-flat models give the displayed localization factorization maps.

The ordinary comparison c preserves the iterated inverse-image and quotient unit sections by hc. Its cochain comparison cc has precisely these components by hcc. On a total summand of bidegree (i,j), both routes send 1 tensor f*(x tensor y) to f*(1 tensor x) tensor f*(1 tensor y). The quotient tensor normalization and the ordinary pullback tensor normalization give these formulas. Balancing, module sheafification and the total-summand inclusions determine the ordinary chain maps, so the two maps agree, with their same signed differential.

Apply the derived quotient to this equality. Use he to replace the cochain quotient/pullback map by e, conjugated by the universal quotient model counits and exact-pullback factorization maps. Naturality of the tensor models cancels the intermediate comparisons. The remaining equality is exactly the required square on the objects Q(P), Q(Q); no extension to arbitrary derived objects is asserted here.

theorem finitePullbackTensor_quotient_representatives {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (c : sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f ⋙
        coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E X h ≅
      coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E Y h ⋙
        sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f)
    (hc : ∀ (M : normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : M.val.obj (Opposite.op U)),
        (c.hom.app M).val.app (Opposite.op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
          (coefficientFiniteQuotientUnitSection l E X h
            ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).obj M)
            (Opposite.op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
            (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
              (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1))).unit.app M).val.app (Opposite.op U) x)) =
        ((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app
            ((coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E Y h).obj M)).val.app (Opposite.op U)
          (coefficientFiniteQuotientUnitSection l E Y h M (Opposite.op U) x))
    (cc : (sfIntrinsicPullback
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E X h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      (coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E Y h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicPullback
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (hcc : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ) (i : ℤ),
      (cc.hom.app P).f i = c.hom.app (P.X i))
    (good : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X m)
        (((sfIntrinsicPullback
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (e : finiteDerivedPullback l E m f ⋙ coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X h ≅
      coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E Y h ⋙ finiteDerivedPullback l E n f)
    (he : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) P),
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
            (coefficientFiniteQuotientModel l E Y h P hP).hom ≫
          (sfIntrinsicPullback
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ =
        (coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X h).map
          ((sfIntrinsicPullback
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          (coefficientFiniteQuotientModel l E X h _
            (good P hP)).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (cc.hom.app P))
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ)
    (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) P)
    (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) Q) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q
    (coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X h).map
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f m hX hY) M N).hom ≫
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).quotientCalculus.tensor h).hom.app
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E m f).obj M,(finiteDerivedPullback l E m f).obj N) ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom (e.hom.app M)
          (e.hom.app N)) =
    e.hom.app
      ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Y m).obj (M,N)) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        (((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).quotientCalculus.tensor h).hom.app (M,N)) ≫
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
        ((coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E Y h).obj M)
        ((coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E Y h).obj N)).hom
